meta.ratings: Each player's effect on points per 100 possessions (offense, defense as points prevented, net), from every possession of the season and the two before it with all ten players on the floor fitted at once, so teammates and opponents are held fixed; older games count less (their weight halves every 591 days); shrunk toward average (ridge); fitted on points net of the six-term skill fit of the lineups and centered each season on the league average per possession. The six factors are the same fit on true shooting, turnovers and offensive rebounds, converted to points by one regression of the net rating on the six.
